card.name: Complex sleep behaviors warning wording
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside warnings about complex sleep behaviors such as sleep-driving, sleepwalking, and eating or phoning while not fully awake. It marks the linking words that come after the phrase 'complex sleep behaviors'.

modes.label: Linking words in the warning
modes.description: Words like including, in, as, or that follow the heading and introduce the list of behaviors.

modes.description: Periods and commas inside the parenthetical list of example behaviors such as preparing food or making phone calls.
